details: Every finite binary class admits a stable unlabeled sample-compression scheme of size at most its minimum star number.
proof: Theorem 23 in the cited paper constructs a stable, sample-consistent unlabeled compression scheme of size $\mathrm S_{\mathrm{min}}$. The optimum stable-unlabeled compression size is therefore no larger.
name: Minimum Star Number / Stable Unlabeled Complexity
